results.title: About Stripe
results.content: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and run internet businesses.

results.title: Stripe, Inc. - Wikipedia
results.content: Stripe, Inc. is an Irish-American financial services and software as a service company. Stripe was founded in 2010 by Irish brothers John Collison and Patrick Collison.

results.title: Stripe - Crunchbase Company Profile
results.content: Stripe has raised a total of $8.7B in funding over 20 rounds. Their latest funding was raised on Mar 14, 2023 from a Series I round.
